CROWS.CritHint: Tier 3 regardless of banes, plus an extra action you must use immediately.
CROWS.DoomHint: Tier 1 regardless of edges or expertises, plus a major setback of the Ref's choosing.
CROWS.DoubleEdgeApplied: Double edge: result improved one tier.
CROWS.DoubleBaneApplied: Double bane: result worsened one tier.
CROWS.RollHint: Click to roll. Shift-click to skip the dialog.
CROWS.EdgeBaneHint: One edge is +2. Two or more is a double edge: no bonus, but the result improves a tier. Banes work the same in reverse, and the two cancel.
CROWS.SelectTargets: Select one or more tokens first.
CROWS.NoActorForRoll: That roll has no actor attached.
CROWS.NotYourRoll: You do not own that actor.
CROWS.CannotApplyExpertise: An expertise cannot improve this result.
CROWS.BacklashNoTable: Backlash! (no Backlashes table found in this world)
CROWS.ExpertiseHint: After a test, spend one use to improve the result by a tier. Click a pip to spend it, click it again to take it back. Uses return when you finish a rest, unless you rested in the Miasma.
CROWS.UsesLeftHint: Uses left before your next rest. Click the pips, or type it. A rest refills this.
CROWS.TrainedHint: Uses trained: what your background gave you plus every advancement bonus you have put here. Permanent, and only the advancement screen changes it.
CROWS.BackgroundHint: One of the 36 backgrounds. It sets a characteristic to 2, your Stamina, a starting trait, your first expertise uses and your kit.
CROWS.PickBackgroundHint: This records which background you have. It does not re-apply its statistics — use the builder for that, so an advanced crow is not reset.
CROWS.FeatureHint: One thing that makes them stand out: a tattoo, a distinct voice, a smell, a habit. There is no table for this — make it up.
CROWS.BonusesToTakeHint: Expertise & Stamina bonuses your total XP has earned but you have not yet taken. Click to take one.
CROWS.CharacteristicBonusesToTakeHint: Characteristic increases your total XP has earned but you have not yet taken. Click to take one.
CROWS.TXPHint: Lifetime XP earned. Advancement bonuses key off this, and spending XP on traits never reduces it.
CROWS.BonusHint: This is a permanent advance, not something a rest hands out. You earn a bonus by crossing a total-XP threshold — nine of them over a whole career — and a rest is only when you are allowed to claim one. Pick ONE of the three below; they are fixed packages, not three points to split.
CROWS.AwardTreasureHint: Recovering treasure is what earns XP. Each crow gains the haul's value in gc divided by the number sharing it.
CROWS.HaulValueHint: Total gc value of the haul. Unique items have no cost — use the XP value printed on their card.
CROWS.HaulLabelPlaceholder: The reliquary under the Blood Library
CROWS.ExclusionsHint: Tick anything that is true and the haul earns no XP. Every one of these is about where it came from, which nothing on the item records.
CROWS.TreasureExcluded: That haul earns no XP: one of the exclusions applies.
CROWS.SharingHint: The divisor is the number of players sharing the haul, not the number of items.
CROWS.NoCrowsSelected: No crows are sharing this haul.
CROWS.NoPlayerCrows: No player-owned crows in this world.
CROWS.HaulTooSmall: Split between that many crows, the haul is worth no XP each.
CROWS.HaulRemainder: {gc} gc left over — settle it at the table.
CROWS.CrossedThreshold: Crosses a threshold: {n} Expertise & Stamina bonus earned.
CROWS.CrossedCharThreshold: Crosses a threshold: {n} characteristic bonus earned.
CROWS.MaxUsesRose: Maximum uses per expertise rises to {n}.
CROWS.ClaimAtRest: Bonuses are taken when you finish a rest.
CROWS.ChangeTokenArtHint: Pick a new image for this crow's token. Updates the prototype and any token already on the map.
CROWS.ChangePortraitHint: Pick a new portrait image for the sheet.
CROWS.PrototypeTokenHint: Everything else about the token: size, vision, light, disposition, name display.
CROWS.ThisTokenHint: Settings for this placed token only, not the prototype.
CROWS.NoMoreThresholds: Every printed threshold passed; a further bonus every {step} total XP
CROWS.ExpertiseUsesHint: Uses are your pool between rests, and a rest refills it. Raising the pool itself is advancement, and permanent.
CROWS.BonusOption.expertise: Three expertise uses, divided as you like
CROWS.BonusOption.split: One expertise use, and +1 Stamina maximum
CROWS.NoUsesToPlace: This option grants no expertise uses.
CROWS.AtCap: Already at the maximum for one expertise
CROWS.UndoBonusConfirm: Give this bonus back? Everything it granted is removed and the bonus becomes available again.
CROWS.UndoWouldStrand: Cannot give this back: {names} no longer has the uses it granted.
CROWS.NoBonusOwed: No bonus is owed at this total XP.
CROWS.NoCharacteristicBonusOwed: No characteristic bonus is owed at this total XP.
CROWS.CharacteristicHint: A separate table with its own thresholds. Each bonus raises one characteristic by 1, to a maximum of 4.
CROWS.CharacteristicAtCap: That characteristic is already at {cap}, the highest advancement can take it. Only magic goes higher.
CROWS.AllCharsMaxed: Every characteristic is at the cap, so this bonus increases your Stamina maximum by 2 instead.
CROWS.RestRequiredHint: You have earned {xp} XP since your last rest. Bonuses and traits can only be taken when you finish a rest after earning the XP.
CROWS.RestRequiredWarning: Finishing a rest now will restore your Stamina, close one wound, return your expertise uses, and end any Prepare for Task.
CROWS.RestUnlocksAdvancement: Rested. You are owed the following, earned from the XP you have already recovered — a rest is when you may take it, not what granted it:
CROWS.OwedBonuses: {n} Expertise & Stamina bonus, earned by passing a total-XP threshold
CROWS.OwedCharBonuses: {n} characteristic bonus, earned by passing a total-XP threshold
CROWS.MaxUsesHint: The most uses any one expertise may be trained to at your current advancement.
CROWS.EffectUDHint: Usage dice tracking the SPELL's duration, which deplete separately from the book's own dice.
CROWS.SpellbookExhausted: {name} has no magic left. Finish a rest to restore its usage dice.
CROWS.HandsHint: Equipped. One item each, no stacking.
CROWS.BackpackHint: Wounds fill these slots. Fill all ten and you die.
CROWS.MagicHint: Two items in one slot: no rest, and 1d6 wounds each dungeon turn.
CROWS.MagicOverloadWarning: Overloaded magic item slot: you cannot rest, and take 1d6 wounds at the end of each dungeon turn.
CROWS.UnplacedHint: Drag onto a slot to carry.
CROWS.NotInPack: That item is not in the backpack.
CROWS.FailedDrawFromPack: Rummaged for {name} but could not reach it.
CROWS.BadMagicSlot: That is not a valid magic item slot.
CROWS.SlotError.doesNotFit: It does not fit there. Multi-slot items need consecutive slots in one container.
CROWS.SlotError.noStackingInHands: You cannot stack items in a hand slot.
CROWS.SlotError.badIndex: That is not a valid slot.
CROWS.SlotError.useMagicSlotKey: Magic items are placed by slot name.
CROWS.DeadBanner: Every backpack slot is wounded. This crow is dead.
CROWS.UDTriggerHint: Each die showing 1 or 2 is removed from the pool.
CROWS.ReachHint: Natural reach in squares, derived from size.
CROWS.IgnoresDarknessHint: Monsters take no penalty from dim light or darkness.
CROWS.WeakHint: Power 9 or lower: may flee from an overwhelming amount of something it hates.
CROWS.HarvestHint: Destroy the corpse for crafting parts. Yield scales with size.
CROWS.Name: Name
CROWS.ADHint: Damage hits Armor Defense first. At 0 the item stops absorbing until repaired.
CROWS.SpeedHint: Reduced by wounds sharing a backpack slot with cargo.
CROWS.CrueltyHint: Each level is -1 to resist the Miasma. Cleared by resting somewhere without Miasma.
CROWS.PreparedHint: +2 on tests for this task until you finish another rest.
CROWS.Rested: {name} finishes a rest: Stamina restored, one wound healed, expertises recovered.
CROWS.RestedInMiasma: {name} rests in the Miasma: Stamina restored and a wound healed, but no expertise uses return.
CROWS.RestInMiasmaPrompt: Is this rest inside the Miasma? Resting in it restores no expertise uses.
CROWS.DTTurnLength: Each dungeon turn is {minutes} minutes of real time.
CROWS.ENHint: An encounter occurs on a d10 result at or above this number, so a HIGHER number is safer.
CROWS.EncounterWarning: Something is coming. Give the crows a sign, then bring it in this turn.
CROWS.GreedHint: Treasure found this early is worth more. The Three rewards boldness.
CROWS.CrowsActFirst: The crows act first this round.
CROWS.EnemiesActFirst: Their enemies act first this round.
CROWS.ItemNeedsOwner: That item is not owned by an actor.
CROWS.PrerequisitesHint: Names of traits in the same tree, any one of which unlocks this.
CROWS.GroupHint: Decides which weapon expertise may improve attacks with it.
CROWS.PiercingHint: Piercing damage ignores Armor Defense and hits Stamina directly.
CROWS.SlotsHint: Multi-slot items need consecutive slots in one container.
CROWS.StackHint: How many fit in one slot. Hands never stack.
CROWS.XPValueHint: Unique items award flat XP instead of a gold price.
CROWS.CraftingGoalHint: Points needed to finish it. Higher takes longer.
CROWS.Settings.WoundSpeedRuleHint: The rule reads 'for each slot occupied by a wound and an item, your speed is reduced by 1'. That parses two ways.
CROWS.Settings.WoundSpeedBoth: Only slots holding BOTH a wound and an item (strict)
CROWS.Settings.WoundSpeedEither: Every slot holding a wound OR an item (loose)
CROWS.Settings.DungeonTurnMinutesHint: Real-world minutes per dungeon turn. The rules suggest 30, with 20 for more pressure and 60 for less.
CROWS.Settings.ShowClock: Show the dungeon turn clock to players
CROWS.Settings.ShowClockHint: The pressure works better when everyone can see the clock.
CROWS.Settings.AutoEncounterCheckHint: Rolls 1d10 against the encounter number at the end of each dungeon turn.
CROWS.Settings.AutoUsageDiceHint: Rolls every dungeon-turn usage pool (torches, ongoing spells) when the turn ends.
CROWS.Settings.TurnEndSound: Play a sound when a dungeon turn ends
CROWS.Settings.TurnEndSoundHint: A torch guttering out should be audible.
CROWS.OrPickHint: or pick one from the list below
CROWS.NoBackgrounds: No backgrounds found. Install the crows.backgrounds compendium, or author background items in the world.
CROWS.NoBackgroundAt: No background at {first}-{second} on the table.
CROWS.WhoGetsHigher: Which of the two remaining takes the higher value?
CROWS.BuilderFooterHint: Applying overwrites this crow's characteristics and Stamina, rolls starting gold, and stows the starting kit into legal slots.
CROWS.TraitNotFound: Could not find the starting trait "{name}". Add it by hand.
CROWS.KitMissing: Not found in any pack, so not added: {names}
CROWS.NoTraitPack: No traits found. Install the crows.traits compendium, or author trait items in the world.
CROWS.PaceSlow: Slow (1 hex, safer, edge on role tests)
CROWS.PaceFast: Fast (3 hexes, riskier, bane on role tests)
CROWS.MagicSlotOverload: Overloaded magic slot: chaos floods the body
CROWS.DTWarning: {minutes} minutes left in this dungeon turn.
CROWS.Settings.TurnWarnings: Warn as the dungeon turn runs down
CROWS.Settings.TurnWarningsHint: A notification and a soft chime at 10, 5 and 1 minutes remaining, so the table can spend the last of the turn deliberately.
CROWS.DTWarningOne: One minute left in this dungeon turn.
CROWS.EditPlacedToken: Configure the token on the canvas
CROWS.NoPlacedToken: This actor has no token on the current scene.
CROWS.AvailableXPHint: Total XP earned, less what you have already spent on traits.
CROWS.AllTreesOpened: You have already invested in every tree.
CROWS.TraitLocked: You do not have a prerequisite for that trait.
CROWS.TraitHasDependents: Cannot give that back: {names} would be left with no prerequisite.
